B. The Most Viewed Products tab is placed between Customers and Bestsellers and the Orders grid does not include a Braintree Transaction Source column.
C. The New Customers tab is placed between Bestsellers and Most Viewed Products, and the Orders grid includes a Braintree Transaction Source column.
